'''Ernst''' is a male [[NPC]] Rabelle College student seen trying to comfort his scared friend, '''Gamov''' from Department of Exostrider Engineering. 

==Idle==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:;'''Gamov''' ...Brr, it's kinda cold in here. Is the A/C cranked up?
:;'''Gamov''' Huh!? I hear water dripping. You hear that?

==Dialogue==
:'''Ernst:''' Dripping water? I don't hear anything. Feels pretty warm to me, actually.
:'''Ernst:''' Come on, it's just the bathroom. What are you scared of?
:'''Gamov:''' Can you... uh... come into the stall with me?
:'''Ernst:''' But it's too small to fit the two of us!
:'''Ernst:''' Ugh, if you binge those deep-sea horror movies again, I'm gonna haunt you myself.
:'''Gamov:''' Oh, please don't do that...
:'''Gamov:''' The bathroom. It's right there...
{{Dialogue End}}
